description:
Commit 35212ca4e23ba11ee01dfcacbdc7deec383073c8 removed ~140 archived spec files
that were superseded by docs/benchmarks/ and docs/platforms/. A post-deletion gap
analysis comparing the deleted specs against the current docs found 11 doc pages
with missing, incorrect, or incomplete content.

Findings are grouped by severity:
- P1: Factually wrong content in docs (must be verified against code before editing)
- P2: Significant functional gaps (entire features or API surfaces undocumented)
- P3: Notable omissions (useful but not blocking)

CRITICAL RULE: Every work unit has a research gate. Run the stated verification
commands FIRST to establish ground truth from the implementation. Never edit docs
solely based on what the spec said - specs were the source of divergence in several
cases (e.g. coffeeshop: spec said 50M orders, code says 8.5M, docs are correct).

anti_patterns.dont: batch all edits into a single commit
anti_patterns.why: if one finding turns out to be wrong, a granular commit history makes it easy to revert just that edit.

anti_patterns.dont: copy text from the archived spec into the doc verbatim
anti_patterns.why: specs were sometimes incorrect (see coffeeshop SF order count discrepancy). Always verify against the implementation first.

anti_patterns.dont: document 'planned' platform support as if it is current
anti_patterns.why: the transaction-primitives spec listed MySQL/Snowflake/Databricks, but those adapters may not be registered in benchmark_registry.py. Only document what is wired up.

anti_patterns.dont: skip the research gate for P1 items
anti_patterns.why: the gap analysis agent found cases where the spec was wrong and the docs were correct. Running the grep commands takes 30 seconds; writing incorrect docs takes hours to fix.

preserves.behavior: All heading hierarchy and tag frontmatter in each .md file
Existing accurate content in each doc page - edits should ADD missing information, not replace correct existing descriptions
The correct SF=1 order count in coffeeshop.md (8.5M) - DO NOT change this to 50M even though the spec said 50M; the code (generator.py:57) is authoritative

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -k 'transaction_primitives or nyctaxi or coffeeshop or amplab or datavault or tpcds or tpcdi' -m fast -q --tb=no 2>&1 | tail -5
verifications.description: Fast benchmark tests still pass after docs edits

verifications.command: cd docs && make linkcheck 2>&1 | grep -c 'broken' || echo '0'
verifications.description: No broken links introduced in docs
